name: Boxing & Fitness for All In Members – Ditherington – 16 September
description: Free funded boxing and fitness session for All In members aged 5–15 at Ditherington Community Centre. The current 4 All Foundation activity listing confirms Wednesdays 16:30–17:30. Legacy partner wording from the source has been omitted because Shropshire Council confirms All In programme management changed in April 2026.

name: Beyond the Book – Broseley Library
description: Free teenage book club with quizzes, word games, crafts, snacks and time to chat about books. Next session 10 October 2026, 11:00–12:00, then monthly dates including 14 November and 12 December.
accessibility: Broseley Library is autism friendly and has disabled access, disabled parking, level entry and disabled toilets.
age_guidance: Teenagers; exact age range not stated

name: Apple Weekend – Acton Scott Heritage Farm
description: Traditional apple-harvest weekend with horse-powered cider making using Acton Scott's stone cider mill, steam engines, heritage-breed animals and the historic farmstead. Runs Saturday 10 and Sunday 11 October 2026, 10:00–16:30. Visitors may bring cider apples and containers for pressed juice; the official page provides ticket booking but the accessible event text checked did not state a price.
accessibility: Acton Scott says the site is fairly flat and generally accessible for pushchairs and wheelchairs, although the visitor route includes some uneven ground and cobbles.
age_guidance: Families; no specific age range stated

name: All Hallows at Blists Hill
description: Family-friendly All Hallows celebration at Blists Hill with autumn folklore, tales of witches and ghosts, traditional superstitions, trails and seasonal family activities. Runs daily 17 October–1 November 2026, 09:30–16:30. The event is free but normal venue admission applies.
accessibility: The National Trust links to its Ironbridge accessibility information. Some areas may be muddy and uneven underfoot; sturdy footwear is recommended.
age_guidance: Families; children must be supervised; no minimum age stated

name: Bumps to Babies Book Group – Shrewsbury Library – 2 October
description: New free monthly book group for parents/carers who want to enjoy a book group without arranging childcare. Books are provided; babies/little ones are welcome, with toys available and hot drinks for adults. First current date 2 October 2026, then 6 November and 4 December. Spaces are limited; contact Shrewsbury Library by email to join.
age_guidance: Parents/carers with babies or little ones; exact child age range not stated

name: Broseley Library Rhyme Time – 1 October
description: Free songs, rhymes, rhythm and fun for children under five. Runs on the first Thursday of each month; current dates include 1 October, 5 November and 3 December 2026.
accessibility: Broseley Library is listed as autism friendly and has disabled access, disabled parking, level entry, disabled toilets and baby-changing facilities.

name: LGBTQ+ at SMAG – 3 October
description: Relaxed monthly meet-up for LGBTQ+ families with young children, with play, chat, coffee and cake. Runs on the first Saturday of each month, 10:30–11:30, through 5 December 2026. No booking needed; just turn up. The official source does not state a price, so none is inferred.
age_guidance: LGBTQ+ families with young children; exact child ages not stated

name: Bounce & Rhyme – Stirchley Community Library – 16 September
description: Free drop-in nursery rhyme and action-song session for babies and toddlers under 5 with parents/carers. Runs every Wednesday 10:30–11:00 at Stirchley Community Library. No booking needed.
age_guidance: Babies and toddlers under 5 with parent/carer

name: Bounce & Rhyme – Newport Library – 18 September
description: Free drop-in nursery rhyme and action-song session for babies and toddlers under 5 with parents/carers. Runs every Friday 10:30–11:00 at Newport Library. No booking needed.
age_guidance: Babies and toddlers under 5 with parent/carer

name: Mini Mammoths – Shrewsbury Museum & Art Gallery – 17 September
description: Weekly Thursday term-time early-years museum session with singing, stories, craft and hands-on museum objects. Runs 10:30–12:00 through 8 July 2027. £6 per child; siblings £5. The current official event page says it is suitable for 12 months–4 years, with babies in arms welcome at no charge; its pricing note says under-1s are free when accompanying an older sibling. Advance booking required.
age_guidance: 12 months–4 years; babies in arms welcome at no charge
